messages:
sasha: Starting rollout for ranking model 'ranker-v3'. Enabling cohort pin 10% for cohortA. Will monitor infra/metrics and plan to shift to 30% at +30m if healthy. Pin config: `ff.ranker_v3.pin=cohortA:10%`. Change window: today 15:00-18:00 PT. @nina @mike please watch latency and error-rate dashboards.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline #4567 triggered for ranker-v3 -> canary on cluster-2. Rollback hook: enabled. Links: https://ci/redwood/4567 :rocket:

mike: Confirming thresholds — what are the circuit breaker numbers? I have a simple guard: p95 > 200ms or errors > 0.5% for 5m and we hold/rollback. Should we tighten for this model?

sasha: Good call. Use p95 > 150ms or errors > 0.3% over 5m as hold threshold for the first 30m. If hit, we pause and run targeted evals. I'll add the threshold to the release notes.

nina: Observing a small p95 uptick on canary (about +8ms) at t=6m. No error spike. :eyes: Dashboard: https://metrics/redwood/ranker-v3

sasha: Hold for now. Do not ramp. Run eval set 'ranking-smoke-20' against canary and baseline. @qa-artem can you run and post results?

qa-artem: Running evals now. Quick snapshot: quality deltas look neutral, latency snapshot p95 +12ms, p99 +40ms on a subset of long queries. No error rate change. Failing queries ~0.2% (non-production). Paste results in 10m.

ashwin: Oncall note — if we need to disable for a subset of customers, we can pin ent customers back to v2 using `redwood pin traffic --model=ranker-v2 --customers=ent-*`. Do we want to prepare that just in case?

sasha: Yes, prepare the pin command but hold execution unless errors > 0.3%. Also prepare `ff` disable: `redwood ff set ranker_v3.pin=cohortA:0%` for fast kill.

mike: Copy. I'll stand by with runbook open. Also adding brief note to release notes: "grace-period hold at +10m if p95 delta > 10ms".

(9m later)

qa-artem: Eval results: precision +0.6%, recall -0.1%, p95 still +12-15ms on long-run queries. No production errors.

nina: Still trending slightly up on tail. Suggest we hold additional 15m and dig into KV-cache misses.

sasha: Agreed. Extending hold +15m. If p95 doesn't come down to within +8ms, we'll roll back. Everyone acknowledged? :thumbsup:

mike: :thumbsup:

ashwin: :thumbsup: ready for pin if needed.

(10m later)

sasha: p95 continues to creep to +22ms—crossing our 150ms guard. Initiating fast disable now.

sasha: `redwood ff set ranker_v3.pin=cohortA:0%` — disabling cohort pin.

deploy-bot: Feature flag update accepted. Traffic shifted away from ranker-v3 for cohortA. Rollback hook: executing full traffic pin to ranker-v2 for all traffic.

deploy-bot: Traffic pinned to ranker-v2 (v2-stable). Canary instances for ranker-v3 drained. CI: https://ci/redwood/4567/rollback

nina: Confirming metrics returning to baseline. p95 back to normal within 2m. Good call.

sasha: Thanks team. Note for postmortem: investigate kv cache warmup and tokenization differences. I'll add follow-up tasks and update release notes with the grace-period hold used and threshold decisions.

mike: I'll file the postmortem and list actions: tighter hold threshold for first 30m, automated smoke eval after +5m, and a pin-by-customer runbook.

qa-artem: Marking eval artifacts under runbook/4567-evals.

sasha: Closing thread. We'll re-start a controlled experiment after fixes. :eyes:
